real_environment: an 1848 Vermont granite railroad cut in bright daylight

wardrobe.foreman_1848: rolled-up white linen shirtsleeves, dark buttoned waistcoat, canvas trousers, broad-brimmed felt hat
wardrobe.foreman_1850_chile: tailored dark waistcoat, crisp white shirt and cravat, closed left eyelid, wide-brimmed stagecoach hat
wardrobe.physician: 1840s dark wool frock coat, high collar, black leather medical bag

must_have_scenes.title: The 1848 Cavendish Railroad Rock-Cut Blast
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: A 1840s railroad foreman tamping black powder into a granite hole with a 3-foot-7-inch iron rod turns his head, sparks the rock, and the rod blasts straight up through his left cheek and skull.
must_have_scenes.era: September 13, 1848, 4:30 p.m., Rutland and Burlington Railroad rock cut near Cavendish, Vermont

key_visual.description: the tamping iron shoots straight up through the porcelain foreman's left cheek below the eye and out the top of his frosted-glass cranium, clean white porcelain chips scattering

must_have_scenes.title: Sitting Upright in the Ox Cart and Greeting Dr. Harlow
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: Minutes after the iron bar pierced his skull, Phineas Gage sits upright in an ox cart, climbs the hotel stairs, and calmly tells Dr. Harlow how the iron passed through his head.
must_have_scenes.era: September 13, 1848, 5:00-6:00 p.m., dirt road and Joseph Adams's hotel porch in Cavendish, Vermont

must_have_scenes.title: Impulsive Outburst in a Cavendish Tavern and Refusal of the Foreman Job
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: Friends and bosses say he is 'no longer Gage' as the once-calm foreman slams a tavern table in a sudden burst of temper and loses his old job.
must_have_scenes.era: Spring 1849, Cavendish, Vermont tavern and railroad contractor office

must_have_scenes.title: Driving a Six-Horse Stagecoach in Chile and the 1850 Daguerreotype Pose
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: Far from the textbook myth of a ruined drifter, a well-dressed Phineas Gage drives a six-horse stagecoach in Chile and poses proudly with the iron bar that pierced his skull.
must_have_scenes.era: 1850-1859, Boston daguerreotype studio and the Valparaiso-to-Santiago mountain road in Chile

must_have_scenes.title: Harvard Warren Anatomical Museum Skull, Tamping Iron, and CT Connectome Mapping
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: At Harvard's Warren Museum, Gage's actual skull and 3-foot-7-inch tamping iron sit side by side, allowing modern CT and connectome scans to map the exact left-frontal wiring the rod severed.
must_have_scenes.era: 1868 to 2012, Warren Anatomical Museum at Harvard Medical School and modern neuroimaging lab

anatomy_descriptors.ventromedial prefrontal cortex: lower front fold behind the left eye

crisis.function: linking emotion to decisions and applying the social brake before impulsive actions
crisis.narration_bridge: Connects Gage's tavern outbursts and lost foreman job to the rod tearing through the judgment center behind his left eye.

step1.function: tagging everyday choices with a rapid gut warning before you say or do something reckless
step1.narration_bridge: Shows how the intact judgment center behind your eyes normally lights up to weigh choices before an impulse turns into action.

step2.function: firing fast emotional signals along white-matter wiring to the front judgment center
step2.narration_bridge: Shows the emotional alarm deep in the brain sending warning signals along white-matter wiring that the iron rod severed on Gage's left side.

step3.function: planning, holding structured routines, and compensating through intact right-side frontal pathways
step3.narration_bridge: Links the spared pathways in the front of the brain to the strict daily stagecoach routine in Chile that helped Gage relearn control.

setup.camera: Wide establishing shot on an 1848 Vermont granite railroad cut in bright sunlight as the camera smoothly tracks forward
setup.action: A matte-white porcelain railroad foreman mannequin in white shirtsleeves and a dark vest kneels over a drilled granite hole, glances back toward two workman mannequins, and tamps a long tapered iron bar down
setup.prop_change: A spark flashes and the iron shoots up through his left cheek and out the top of his frosted-glass cranium, porcelain chips scattering
setup.reaction: He falls back onto the granite as the workmen duck

symptom.camera: Medium tracking shot along a sunlit 1848 Cavendish dirt road beside a wooden hotel porch as the camera glides beside an ox cart
symptom.action: The porcelain foreman mannequin in a singed shirt and head bandage grips the wooden cart rail, steps down onto the road, and walks up the porch stairs toward a physician mannequin in a dark wool coat
symptom.prop_change: The spoked wooden cart wheel creaks to a stop and the physician snaps open the brass clasp of his black leather bag
symptom.reaction: The foreman mannequin touches his left cheekbone while the physician freezes with raised hands

failure.camera: Smooth lateral tracking shot across a sunlit 1849 Vermont tavern and contractor room with heavy oak tables
failure.action: The porcelain foreman mannequin in a wool vest with a closed left eyelid slams his fist onto the oak table and shoves a wooden chair back as a boss mannequin pulls away a work ledger
failure.prop_change: A pewter mug topples and clatters across the oak tabletop, spilling amber liquid as the leather roster ledger slams shut
failure.reaction: Two crewman mannequins recoil a step backward and fold their arms as the foreman snatches his steel rod and strides out

crisis.camera: Dive through the frosted-glass cranium, glide over the gyri and sulci, zoom into the left ventromedial prefrontal cortex

pivot.camera: Dynamic low-angle tracking shot along a sunlit 1850s mountain coach road between Valparaiso and Santiago in Chile
pivot.action: The porcelain foreman mannequin in a tailored dark vest, cravat, and wide-brimmed hat climbs onto the high wooden stagecoach box, grips the leather reins of six porcelain horses, and flicks the reins
pivot.prop_change: The leather reins snap taut, the wooden coach wheels roll forward kicking up golden dust, and the brass coach lamps sway
pivot.reaction: The driver mannequin braces his shoulders with steady hands while passenger mannequins nod inside the rolling coach

step1.camera: Macro tracking along the signal path into the ventromedial prefrontal cortex

step2.camera: Macro tracking along the severed white-matter tract from the amygdala to the ventromedial prefrontal cortex

step3.camera: Macro tracking along the signal path, then pull back to the full prefrontal cortex circuit

breakthrough.camera: Smooth push-in across a bright gallery at Harvard's Warren Anatomical Museum in crisp daylight
breakthrough.action: A porcelain neuroscientist mannequin in a white lab coat lifts the long tapered steel rod from a brass cradle and aligns it beside the left cheekbone of the mounted skull model on a turntable
breakthrough.prop_change: The brass turntable rotates smoothly and a glass display case door swings open beside the 1850 plaster life cast
breakthrough.reaction: Two researcher mannequins lean forward and grip the table edge in amazement as the left-sided path lines up

conclusion.camera: Slow pull-back rising to an elevated wide shot inside a sunlit 1850s daguerreotype studio and coach courtyard
conclusion.action: The well-dressed porcelain foreman mannequin in a tailored waistcoat and cravat grips his long tapered iron bar upright against his shoulder and steps beside the six-horse stagecoach team
conclusion.prop_change: A brass studio plate holder slides into place with a crisp click while sunlight glints along the polished iron bar and leather harness
conclusion.reaction: The foreman mannequin squares his shoulders with his left eyelid closed and holds the bar steady in quiet dignity

scenes.crisis: The camera dives smoothly through the railroad foreman mannequin's translucent frosted-glass cranium into a bright white studio gallery holding an architectural cross-section cutaway of a realistic matte-white brain with visible gyri and sulci. It glides under the left frontal base and zooms into the ventromedial prefrontal cortex behind the left eye, which is severed along the rod's upward path and glowing crimson-red as as the internal light pulse halts cleanly at the severed tract margin and dims quietly to stillness.
scenes.step1: Macro view inside the architectural cross-section cutaway of the matte-white brain in bright studio daylight. a smooth bioluminescent green light pulse glides inside the fiber tracts into the ventromedial prefrontal cortex just above the eye sockets, lighting the intact judgment center electric cyan-blue as it weighs a choice and sends a calming pulse backward. The camera tracks the flowing signal along the orbital folds while the rest of the brain stays matte white.
scenes.step2: Inside the architectural cross-section cutaway of the matte-white brain in bright studio daylight, the almond-shaped amygdala deep in the left temporal lobe pulses electric cyan-blue and sends a smooth bioluminescent green pulse inside the uncinate white-matter tract toward the ventromedial prefrontal cortex. At the crimson-red gap where the rod passed on the left side, the severed nerve cables end abruptly and the as the internal light pulse halts cleanly at the severed tract margin and dims quietly to stillness.
scenes.step3: The camera pulls back to reveal the whole circuit inside the matte-white brain in bright studio daylight. While the lower left lesion stays dimmed crimson-red, intact pathways across the surrounding prefrontal cortex ignite warm amber-gold, guiding a smooth bioluminescent green pulse inside intact tracts across the front of the brain. Strong rim light traces the cortical folds as the full brain turns slowly in the light.
